    Profile

    Filo is a creature known as a Filolial Queen from the country of Melromarc from a parallel world. Though she belongs to a bird-like monster species called filolials, she has the ability to shapeshift into the form of a young girl. Having a natural affinity for wind-type magic, she is able to use it to her advantage in battle. She loves to sing and pull horse-drawn carriages.
